title: documenttemplate
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

clientdata.description: Client data regarding this document template.

createdon.description: Date and time when the document template was created.

description.description: Additional information to describe the Document Template

documenttemplateid.description: Unique identifier of the document template.

documenttype.description: Option set for selecting the type of the document template

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the document template was last modified.

status.description: Information about whether the document template is active.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the document template.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the document template.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the document template.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the document template.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the web resource.
